moments.title: Halloween Weekend is Here!
moments.blurb: The UK is gearing up for Halloween on Saturday, October 31st, with events ranging from family-friendly pumpkin patches to terrifying scare attractions across the country.

angles.name: Spooky Saturday
angles.copy: Who's ready for a frightfully good Halloween weekend? From spooky trails to full-on scare fests, how are you celebrating?

angles.name: Family Fun
angles.copy: Pumpkin carving, fancy dress, or a not-so-spooky storytime – how are the little monsters celebrating Halloween this year?

moments.title: Bonfire Night Approaches
moments.blurb: Bonfire Night, commemorating Guy Fawkes and the Gunpowder Plot, falls on Thursday, November 5th, with many firework displays and community events planned across the UK for the surrounding weekend.

angles.name: Remember, Remember
angles.copy: Bonfire Night is just a week away! Get ready for crackling bonfires, dazzling fireworks, and maybe a few toasted marshmallows. What are your plans?

angles.name: Local Displays
angles.copy: From Battersea Park to Ascot Racecourse, Bonfire Night displays are lighting up the UK. Check local listings for events near you, including family-friendly options.

moments.title: Premier League Matchweek 9
moments.blurb: Premier League Matchweek 9 kicks off this weekend, with a major clash between Chelsea and Manchester United on Saturday, October 31st, and Liverpool facing Arsenal on Sunday, November 1st.

angles.name: Big Game Buzz
angles.copy: It's a huge weekend in the Premier League! Chelsea vs Man Utd on Saturday – who's taking all three points?

angles.name: Sunday Showdown
angles.copy: Liverpool vs Arsenal headlines Sunday's Premier League action. Who are you backing in this top-of-the-table battle?

moments.title: Championship Action This Weekend
moments.blurb: The EFL Championship sees a full slate of fixtures on Saturday, October 31st, including Welsh clubs Cardiff City, Swansea City, and newly promoted Wrexham AFC in action.

angles.name: Welsh Derby Day
angles.copy: Big Championship day on Saturday! Cardiff City are away at Wolves, Swansea City host Blackburn Rovers, and Wrexham travel to Sheffield United. Good luck to the Welsh clubs!

angles.name: Who Will Rise?
angles.copy: Every point counts in the Championship! Which team are you following closely this weekend?

moments.title: Autumn Rugby Internationals Begin
moments.blurb: The Autumn Rugby Internationals kick off next weekend as part of the new Nations Championship, with Wales facing Japan at Principality Stadium on Friday, November 6th.

angles.name: Wales Kicks Off
angles.copy: Get ready for international rugby! Wales take on Japan next Friday in Cardiff to kick off their Autumn Nations Championship campaign. Cymru am byth!

angles.name: Home Nations in Action
angles.copy: England face Australia and Scotland play New Zealand next Friday as the Autumn Internationals begin. Who's excited for some world-class rugby?

moments.title: Jamie Miller Tops UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' is officially the UK's number one single for the week ending October 29, 2026.

angles.name: New Number One
angles.copy: Huge congratulations to Jamie Miller! 'Babydoll' has officially landed the UK Singles Chart top spot this week. What a tune!

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Turn it up! Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' is your new UK Number 1. What's your favourite track in the chart right now?

moments.title: J. Cole Live at The O2
moments.blurb: Rapper J. Cole continues his 'The Fall Off' tour with shows at London's O2 Arena from today, October 29th, through to November 2nd.

angles.name: London Calling
angles.copy: J. Cole is at The O2 in London tonight and through the weekend! Who's heading to 'The Fall Off' tour?

angles.name: Still Got Tickets?
angles.copy: If you're in London, there might still be a chance to catch J. Cole live at The O2 over the next few days. Don't miss out!

moments.title: Duran Duran Play London
moments.blurb: New Wave legends Duran Duran are performing in London on Saturday, October 31st.

angles.name: Wild Boys in London
angles.copy: Duran Duran are bringing the hits to London this Saturday! Who's excited to see the iconic 80s band live?

angles.name: Still Rocking
angles.copy: From 'Rio' to their latest, Duran Duran still know how to put on a show. Catch them in London this Halloween weekend.

moments.title: The Script UK Tour Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The Script begin their UK tour on Friday, October 30th, supporting their new album 'The User's Guide to Being Human', with dates including Cardiff.

angles.name: Tour Starts Now
angles.copy: The Script are back on tour! Kicking off tomorrow, who's got tickets to see them across the UK, including their Cardiff date?

angles.name: New Album, New Tour
angles.copy: Excited to hear new tracks and old favourites? The Script's UK tour starts tomorrow, celebrating their latest album. Where are you seeing them?

moments.title: Stevie Wonder Returns to London
moments.blurb: Music icon Stevie Wonder will perform in London on November 3rd and 5th, celebrating 50 years of 'Songs In The Key Of Life'.

angles.name: Legendary Gigs
angles.copy: Stevie Wonder in London next week! Celebrating 50 years of an absolute masterpiece, 'Songs In The Key Of Life'. Who's lucky enough to have tickets?

angles.name: Timeless Talent
angles.copy: A true legend gracing the London stage. Stevie Wonder's shows promise to be unforgettable nights of soul and classic hits.

moments.title: Happy 65th to Randy Jackson
moments.blurb: Randy Jackson, youngest brother of The Jacksons and a talented singer, turns 65 today, October 29th.

angles.name: 65 Today
angles.copy: Sending birthday wishes to Randy Jackson, who turns 65 today! What's your favourite Jacksons track?

angles.name: Music Royalty
angles.copy: From The Jacksons to his solo work, Randy Jackson has been part of music history. Happy 65th birthday!

moments.title: Happy 38th to Tove Lo
moments.blurb: Swedish pop sensation Tove Lo, known for hits like 'Habits (Stay High)' and 'Talking Body', celebrates her 38th birthday today, October 29th.

angles.name: Pop Queen
angles.copy: Happy 38th Birthday to the incredible Tove Lo! What's your go-to track from her?

angles.name: Dancing Queen
angles.copy: From indie pop to dance anthems, Tove Lo always delivers. Celebrate her 38th birthday by cranking up her biggest hits!

moments.title: Melba Moore Turns 81
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning R&B and Broadway star Melba Moore, known for her powerful vocals and stage presence, celebrates her 81st birthday today, October 29th.

angles.name: Soulful Legend
angles.copy: Happy 81st Birthday to the incomparable Melba Moore! A true icon of soul, R&B, and Broadway.

angles.name: Broadway Star
angles.copy: From 'I Got Love' to her incredible stage career, Melba Moore is a force of nature. Wishing her a very happy 81st birthday!

moments.title: Grace Slick Turns 87
moments.blurb: Counterculture icon Grace Slick, the legendary singer of Jefferson Airplane and Jefferson Starship, celebrates her 87th birthday tomorrow, October 30th.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the incredible Grace Slick turns 87! What's your favourite psychedelic anthem from Jefferson Airplane?

angles.name: White Rabbit Queen
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th to the legendary voice behind some of rock's most iconic songs. Grace Slick, a true pioneer!

moments.title: Anthony Kiedis Turns 64
moments.blurb: Red Hot Chili Peppers frontman Anthony Kiedis, known for his energetic performances and distinctive vocals, celebrates his 64th birthday on November 1st.

angles.name: Rock Star Birthday
angles.copy: Get ready to rock! Anthony Kiedis of Red Hot Chili Peppers turns 64 this Sunday. What's your favourite RHCP track?

angles.name: Funk Rock Legend
angles.copy: From 'Under the Bridge' to 'Californication', Anthony Kiedis has led one of the biggest bands in the world. Happy 64th for Sunday!

moments.title: Bryan Adams Turns 67
moments.blurb: Canadian rock icon Bryan Adams, famous for power ballads and rock anthems, celebrates his 67th birthday on November 5th.

angles.name: Summer of '69 Forever
angles.copy: It's Bryan Adams' birthday next Thursday! The Canadian rock legend turns 67. What's your ultimate Bryan Adams singalong?

angles.name: Rock Ballad King
angles.copy: From 'Everything I Do' to 'Run To You', Bryan Adams has given us decades of hits. Happy 67th for November 5th!

moments.title: Joni Mitchell Turns 83
moments.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Joni Mitchell, a highly influential figure in folk and jazz, celebrates her 83rd birthday on November 7th.

angles.name: Folk Legend
angles.copy: The iconic Joni Mitchell turns 83 this Saturday! Celebrate her incredible songwriting and timeless voice.

angles.name: Big Yellow Taxi
angles.copy: From 'Big Yellow Taxi' to 'Both Sides Now', Joni Mitchell's music has touched generations. Happy 83rd for November 7th!

moments.title: Classics Galore! Returns to Exeter
moments.blurb: The 'Classics Galore! Last Night of the Proms' concert returns to Exeter's University Great Hall on Saturday, November 14th, featuring over 200 musicians and singers to raise funds for FORCE Cancer Charity.

angles.name: Exeter's Own Proms
angles.copy: Tickets are on sale now for Classics Galore! - Exeter's Last Night of the Proms – returning to the Great Hall on November 14th to support FORCE Cancer Charity. A fantastic night for a great cause!

angles.name: Music for a Cause
angles.copy: Enjoy an evening of orchestral and choral music with over 200 performers at Classics Galore! in Exeter. Book your tickets and support FORCE Cancer Charity.

moments.title: Welsh Water Supplier Event in Newport
moments.blurb: Dŵr Cymru Welsh Water is hosting a major supplier engagement event at ICC Wales, Newport, on November 10th, aiming to maximise opportunities for local businesses in its £600 million infrastructure upgrade.

angles.name: Local Business Boost
angles.copy: Attention Welsh businesses! Dŵr Cymru Welsh Water is holding a major supplier event in Newport on November 10th for their huge infrastructure project. A great chance for local companies!

angles.name: Newport Opportunities
angles.copy: Interested in supplying to a £600m project? Welsh Water's event at ICC Wales, Newport, next week is a must-attend for potential partners.
